title: 03. After Move 5: Midgame Awareness (26k–22k)
description: Bridge the gap past the opening: respond to aggressive invasions, claim open territory, and avoid chasing strong groups.

puzzles.title: Punishing an Aggressive Attachment
puzzles.prompt: Move 6: You own C3 and E5. White aggressively attaches right against your C3 stone at D3. Stand up solid to protect your corner!

solutions.feedback: Textbook Hane/Extend! Standing up at C4 keeps your C3 stone connected toward your E5 center stone while securing the left side.
Strong! Pressing at D4 uses your E5 ally to surround White's aggressive D3 stone.

wrongHints.default: When the opponent touches your stone directly, respond locally! Extend upward at C4 or press on top at D4 to link with E5.

puzzles.title: Big Empty Side vs. Small Endgame
puzzles.prompt: Move 7: Both corners on the top are settled, while the entire bottom half of the board is wide open. Claim the biggest remaining territory!

solutions.feedback: Big-picture awareness! While the top is crowded, C3 stakes out the entire open bottom-left quadrant in a single move.
Big-picture awareness! G3 claims the wide-open bottom-right quadrant while the top is already contested.
Good! E3 stakes out the open bottom 3rd line where the largest points remain.

wrongHints.default: Stop adding stones to the crowded top area—look at the empty bottom half of the board and claim a 3-3 corner (C3 or G3)!

puzzles.title: 2-Step Corner Defense
puzzles.prompt: White invades your corner at B3 while you hold C4 and E4. Block White's escape along the side!

steps.feedback: Good block at B4! White pushes into C3 trying to make a base. Now seal the bottom exit!
Sealed! D3 connects with your C4-E4 wall and traps White's B3-C3 stones inside a cramped corner with minimal eye space.

wrongHints.default: Keep White trapped in the corner: block above at B4 first, then seal the right side at D3.
